faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you want to know about the AI voice widget

items.question: What is an AI voice widget?
items.answer: An AI voice widget is an intelligent chat and voice interface that can be added directly to your website. It lets your visitors talk to an AI assistant that can answer questions, book meetings and handle enquiries – automatically, 24 hours a day.

items.question: How do I add the widget to my website?
items.answer: It takes under 5 minutes. You get a simple JavaScript snippet that you paste into your website. The widget is compatible with every platform, including WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace and custom-built sites.

items.question: Can the AI widget book meetings automatically?
items.answer: Yes. The widget integrates directly with your calendar (Google Calendar, Outlook and others) and makes sure new bookings land automatically, without you having to lift a finger.

items.question: What does the AI widget cost?
items.answer: The starter plan costs 999 kr/month and includes 150 minutes of talk time. You only pay for active talk time – no hourly wage, no commitment.

items.question: Which languages does the widget support?
items.answer: The widget supports Danish and a wide range of other languages. The AI assistant automatically adapts to whichever language the customer speaks.

items.question: Is the widget GDPR compliant?
items.answer: Yes. All data is handled in accordance with GDPR rules, and you have full control over which information is stored.
